parts:
Hello everyone!

My name is Wei.

I used shiny not so long and I really need to know how to use my own icon in shiny.

I read the reference in the Shiny website, but I didn't get the answer.

Sorry for my poor English, but I really want to know how to solve this problem.

Thanks!

messages.author: 679d1df1e5fec530
messages.subject: Re: Question about icon.
parts:
Hi Wei, 

The answer is here: https://rstudio.github.io/leaflet/markers.html. you can create you own icon by uploading and image, then referencing the image in the addMarker() call. 

In addition to this: is it possible to change the size of the icon by zoom level? Or make your icon transparent? 

thank you, 

John
